FINDING: John Wesley, Charles Wesley (the elder), and George Whitefield were instrumental in founding Methodism.

This group laid the foundational stones for what would eventually become Methodism.

Charles Wesley is closely tied to the Great Awakening in the United States and was influential in shaping the broader context of revivalism across multiple countries and denominations. This connection helps trace how ideas and practices stemming from British and American revivals interlocked and evolved.
